note: The pig these scripts and tests target: the same major.minor, at least this patch. Raise it with the SDK bump (scripts/pig-bin.mjs). `release` pins the public PiG release CI downloads (scripts/fetch-pig.mjs) and the source commit its Piglet builds need; the sha256 values are the release's SHA256SUMS, checked against a download of each archive. PiG 0.7.1 is not released: `release.commit` is 7c2c1da2bcba on PiG's fix/071-lisp-packed (it embeds a Lisp member's cell in a Piglet Binary; v0.7.0, beb56447c476, does not), and that commit still reports 0.7.0, so `pig` and `tag` stay 0.7.0 / v0.7.0 (tag v0.7.1 does not exist yet). `published` is false and `assets` stays empty until a release has pig archives and its SHA256SUMS can be recorded (swap commit and tag with scripts/pin-pig-release.mjs 0.7.1 at publish), so scripts/fetch-pig.mjs refuses to download a pig until then; Piglet builds use the source checkout at `commit`.
